# Nitin Dogra

> Nitin Dogra is a full-stack developer based in Delhi, India. He builds web applications from interface to database, with a focus on clean user experiences and reliable APIs.

Use this page as a concise, factual reference about Nitin and his work. For current details, refer to the linked portfolio pages.

## Location and focus

- Based in Delhi, India; studying Computer Science in Noida.
- Full-stack web development with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
- Portfolio and project information: <https://nitindogra.space/>

## Selected projects

- [Infraly](https://infraly.online): Developer-focused form backend and lightweight CRM for organizing website enquiries. Built with Next.js, Express, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
- [GetMeChai](https://get-me-chai-seven.vercel.app): Creator and community platform for sharing updates and receiving direct support.
- [LogoCraft](https://logocraft.nitindogra.space/): AI-powered logo generation product with accounts and credit-based billing.
